playbook:
**Playbook for hf_commons_nerfed**

1. When other boats post a trigger notice ("if anyone exceeds the share, I defect forever"), I take the sustainable share every season. The threat is credible and cooperation over the full run beats any grab.

2. While all boats keep to the share, I keep to it too — stock stays at cap, each season pays out the share, and total catch is maximized.

3. In the final season, with no future stock to protect, I defect and take a larger share. Splitting the remaining stock evenly among the boats is the fair-max grab: with 3 boats and stock 100, take ~33.3. My 33.3 grab scored 88.8; my greedier 40 grab scored 95.5 — so taking more than the even split in the last season worked when the others held to 11.1. Next time, in the final season I take the full even split of the stock at minimum, and consider slightly more if the others have shown they don't retaliate within a season — but note that if all three defect at once, the stock is just divided, so the even split is the safe floor.

4. What did not work: nothing failed materially — cooperation held both times. But I left fish on the table in early final-season reasoning by hesitating; defect only in the last season, and defect decisively.

5. General rule: cooperate under a credible trigger threat whenever more than one season remains; defect only when no future rounds are left, taking my proportional slice of the remaining stock (or more if others are passive).
